title: Routing densities and representation contraction for Thorp sweeps
summary: For $`N=2^d`$ cards, we prove that an absolute number of coordinate sweeps of the Thorp shuffle brings the full permutation law to total-variation distance tending to zero from uniform. The mixing time therefore has optimal order $`\Theta(\log N)`$ in physical shuffles.
family_title: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle

review.reason: Analyzes Thorp shuffle mixing, showing Theta(log N) physical shuffles suffice for uniformity.
